Figma's `Shape` (Search/Default): `rounded` is a pill, Corner-Radius/Rounded on the field, so its stroke, inset
shadow and focus ring follow, and on the filter affordance; `default` keeps Corner-Radius/Input of the size.
Prefer `rounded` for searches on phone screens. Default `default`, but `rounded` inside a TopNavigation control bar

props.name: filterLabel
props.description: Label paired with the chevron in the Filter-Dropdown variant. Default: the locale's "All".

props.name: filterInteractive
props.description: Filter-Icon / Filter-Dropdown trailing is an `InputLeadingTrailing`: clickable by default, `false` makes it decorative.

props.name: onFilterClick
props.description: Action for the filter affordance (e.g. open a filter panel or your own menu).

props.name: filterHasPopup
props.description:

props.name: filterExpanded
props.description: `aria-expanded` of that filter affordance: whether the surface it opens is open now. Pair it with `filterHasPopup`.

props.name: filterOptions
props.description: Filter-Dropdown picker: options open the shared Popover and replace `filterLabel` with the selected label.

props.name: filterActionLabel
props.description: Accessible name / Popover heading for the filter affordance. Default: the locale's "Filter".

props.name: disabled
props.description:
Search/Default is a `.Primitives/Input/Field-Only` instance, so Disabled is Field-Only State=Disabled
(Input/Border/Disabled, Content/Disabled text) with its Leading/Trailing at Active=No. The clear button and the
shortcut hint are hidden and the filter is locked. Use it when searching is unavailable for a reason the page shows.

props.name: shortcut

props.description: Move focus into the popover when it opens (use when it was opened from the keyboard).

props.description: Called with `false` on a pointer-down outside the popover (and outside `anchorRef`) or on Escape.

props.name: searchClearable
props.description: Show the Search clear button while it has a value (Figma Search/Popover Typing/Inputted).

props.name: align
props.description: Preferred horizontal edge against the anchor box; flips when it would overflow the viewport.

props.name: multiple
props.description: Multi-select list: every item gets a trailing Checkbox/Mark (Figma multi-select Popover).

props.name: width
props.description:
Horizontal resizing. Unset keeps Figma Popover/Default's Fixed 240px. Figma gives the set a 240px min width, so every
value below stays at least 240px wide, and at most the viewport less 16px on each side.
`"fill"`: as wide as the anchor box (the trigger, or the field's input box): suggestions under a long search bar.
`"hug"`: as wide as its longest row, never narrower than the anchor box: long names (domains, file paths) stay whole.
A number: a Fixed width in px.

Controlled collapse callback used by the Figma Basic/Small-Density header control. Without it the control is
not rendered. Ignored by `variant="workspace"`, which has no collapsed state.

Replaces the header's logo slots; the collapse control (with `onCollapsedChange`) follows it. In the collapsed rail

props.name: selectedId

Id of the current page's item: it is marked selected (aria-current="page") and its parent groups open (and stay

 When set, it replaces the items' own `selected` / `active` flags in the navigation (not in the workspace rail).

props.name: linkAs

Component that renders items with an `href`, e.g. your router's link. It receives `href`, `className`, `onClick`,

props.description: Default true: DatePicker is the calendar panel itself. As a popover, pass `open` with `onOpenChange` (or `onClose`).

props.name: value
props.description: Single mode, controlled: the selected date. With `showActions` it is the applied date; picks stay a draft until Submit.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Single mode, uncontrolled: the date selected at first.

props.name: range
props.description: Range mode, controlled: the selected range. With `showActions` it is the applied range; picks stay a draft until Submit.

props.name: defaultRange
props.description: Range mode, uncontrolled: the range selected at first.

props.name: month
props.description: First (left) visible month.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description:
Called with each picked date; in range mode with the start, then again with the end (see `onRangeChange`). With
`showActions` a pick is a draft: read the applied value in `onApply`.

props.name: onRangeChange
props.description:
Range mode: called with the new start (end = null) and again once the end date is picked. With `showActions`
these are drafts: read the applied range in `onApply`.

props.name: onApply
props.type: (value: Date | null, range: DatePickerRange | null, time?: DatePickerTime) => void
props.description:
With `showActions`, pressing Submit (the Primary action) applies the picks, then closes a popover. Called with the
picked date (single mode; null in range mode) and the picked range (range mode; null in single mode). An
uncontrolled picker keeps what was applied and Cancel returns to it; a controlled one expects `value` / `range` to
follow. Inline, Submit is disabled until there is a change, and in range mode until the end date is picked.

props.name: onCancel
props.description:
With `showActions`, pressing Cancel (the Tertiary action) drops the picks made since the last Submit (the

props.name: width
props.description:
Horizontal resizing, as in Figma auto layout. Unset keeps the element's usual width.
`"hug"` (Hug contents): as wide as its content, never grows or stretches.
`"fill"` (Fill container): in a row Stack it takes an equal share of the space left after each child's padding
and may shrink to 0; in a column Stack it stretches across; in a Grid cell or a plain block it takes the full
width. Fill children in a wrapping row need a `minWidth` to wrap.
A number: Fixed width in px, which never shrinks in a flex row. Sizes include padding and border (border-box).
(Container's `maxWidth` is a different prop: a token width, sm…full.)
Prefer hug or fill; use Fixed only for widths that really are fixed (a side column, a preview frame).

direction (vertical in a row, horizontal in a column), vertical inside a Grid cell. Overrides the parent's `align`
for this child. A `"fill"` size on the same axis still fills; in a column, alignSelf then places it once maxWidth
stops it. No effect outside a Stack or Grid.

props.name: height
props.description:
Vertical resizing, as in Figma auto layout. Unset keeps the element's usual height.
`"hug"` (Hug contents): as tall as its content, never grows or stretches.
`"fill"` (Fill container): in a column Stack it takes an equal share of the free height; it shrinks below its
content only when the column has a height of its own (Fixed, Fill or maxHeight), else it keeps its content height
(pass `minHeight={0}` for a scrolling child of a column sized from outside). In a row Stack it stretches to the
row's height; in a Grid cell it fills the cell (over alignSelf); in a plain block it takes 100% (the parent needs
a height).
A number: Fixed height in px, which does not shrink in a column Stack.

props.name: minHeight
props.description: Minimum height in px (Figma min height). Wins over fill's shrink-to-0.

props.name: maxHeight
props.description: Maximum height in px (Figma max height).

props.name: position
props.description:
Figma "Ignore auto layout" (layoutPositioning ABSOLUTE). `"absolute"` takes the element out of its parent's flow
and pins it to the parent Stack, Grid, Box or Card with `constraintX` / `constraintY`; siblings, `gap`, `justify`
and the parent's Hug size ignore it, as in Figma. Siblings written after it paint above it (Figma auto layout
"Last on top"), so put background media first. Default `"static"` (in flow). Only Stack, Grid and Box take it:
wrap a Text or a component in a Box. Badges, status dots and a Card sub-action are component props, never insets.

props.description:

· `left-right` (Left & right: stretches between the two offsets, `width` is ignored) · `center` (Center: exact
centre, the X offsets are ignored). Figma Scale is not offered (it needs percentages, which are not tokens).

props.name: constraintY
props.description:
Figma vertical constraint, read only with `position="absolute"`: `top` (default) · `bottom` · `top-bottom`
(Top & bottom: stretches between the two offsets, `height` is ignored) · `center` (exact centre).

xl 24 · 2xl 32 · 3xl 40 · 4xl 48; Figma Y snapped to the padding ladder). Read only when `constraintY` pins the
top edge (`top`, `top-bottom`). Default none (flush). Measured from the parent's padding box, as Figma ignores the
frame's padding for absolute children. A number is px: Figma's Y in a free frame (a Box or Screen without auto
layout, where Zen Studio draws shapes and frames); it may be negative (the layer starts above the frame and clips).

props.description: Offset from the parent's right edge on Spacing/Padding, or px in a free frame. Read only when `constraintX` is `right` or `left-right`. Default none.

over `padding`; unset corners keep `radius`. Don't mix `full` with a finite corner (`radius="full"
radiusBottomRight="xs"`): `full` is Corner-Radius/Rounded (1000px), so the browser scales every corner down to fit
the box and the small one renders square. Use a finite radius (a chat tail: `radius="xl" radiusBottomRight="xs"`);

props.description:

screen's heading (h1 · Heading/1 by default); once `collapsed` it leaves and the bar title (`title`, else this text)
becomes the heading, so the screen keeps exactly one h1 before and after scrolling.

above the large title — "Welcome home" over "Hi, Mai Anh" (◇ Master-Layout · Example F1 15991:10116), a brand over a
device name (F3–F10), "GOOD MORNING" (D5 15952:9644). Body/Base/Regular in Content/Neutral/Light (On-Black-Overlay/Base
on the overlay and on-colour types), Spacing/Gap/2XSmall (4) above the title, 3XSmall (2) at h3. It is not part of the

Figma Expand-Heading › Main-Heading-Text Subheading (Subheading on): a line under the large title — "6 devices · 4 on"
under "Living room" (F2), "Living room" under "HomePod mini" (F3), "One tap for many devices" under

already has its h1. The large title's style follows the level (h1 Heading/1 · h2 Heading/2 · h3 Heading/3); the

props.description: Figma Top-Leading: an action (usually Back) or a visual (e.g. an Avatar).

props.name: trailing
props.description:
Figma Top-Trailing: up to three places (its Trailing-Slot takes 3); more are not drawn. A place is an action (a 44px
Nav-Action), a pair of actions with the same `group` (one pill), or a visual drawn as it is — a Badge or an Avatar,
as Figma puts them straight in the Trailing-Slot: an Orange "3" Badge (Medium, icon-zap-line) and a 48 Avatar
(Medium) on D3 15950:9324, a 56 square Avatar (Large) on D4 15950:9696. The places stay
Navigation-Mobile/Top/Action-Button-Gap (8) apart in the fixed Navigation-Mobile/Top/Bar-Size (64) row, so a 56
Avatar overhangs the 8px padding instead of growing the bar. A visual is not a button: when it opens something (the
account), pass an action, or make the node itself a labelled button. `null` / `false` items take no place.

props.name: largeTitleAction
props.description:
Figma Expand-Trailing (Header-Trailing): one place, or a list of up to three, beside the large title — actions or
visuals, as `trailing` (D3 and D5 15952:9644 put their Badge and Avatar here). When the bar row folds into the
large-title row (a root, see `topBar`) they sit first in the trailing slot, so they stay in place and in reach once
the title folds; the bar still draws three places in all.

props.name: topBar
props.description:
Figma Top-bar: the navigator-bar row. By default a root (a large title and no `leading`) hides it while the large title
shows, as Figma's root screens do (Top-bar=false): the trailing actions sit at the right of the large-title row, and
once the title folds the bar title shows in that same row, so the header keeps its height. `true` keeps the row
above the large title (the iOS layout); `false` hides it on any screen with a large title.

`false` without a large title (Figma Top-bar=false with Expand-Heading off, ◇ Master-Layout · Example D2 15948:9920:
a welcome screen under a brand band) draws no bar row at all: only the status-bar inset, then `controlBar` and
`banner` if any; `leading`, `trailing` and `subtitle` are not drawn. A `title` stays the screen's heading
(`headingLevel`) for screen readers only, so the screen keeps its one title; leave `title` out when the content
draws the screen's h1. With nothing left to hold, the root is a plain `<div>`, not an empty `<header>` landmark.

props.name: controlBar
props.description:
Figma Control-Bar slot (12014:44764): a Search, Segmented, Tabs or a Progress under the heading. The row hugs its
control: the bar's side margin and Spacing/Padding/XSmall (8) above and below it (a 24px Progress makes a 40px row),
none above and below a Tabs (its row is the bar). Several controls stack Spacing/Gap/XSmall apart.

props.name: banner
props.description:
A status that must stay in view while the screen scrolls (offline, syncing, read-only): a Small AlertBanner pinned
under the bar and the control bar, edge to edge. It never scrolls away; with `scrollRef` it moves up with the fold,
like a pinned control bar. One banner at a time; the screen's content starts below it.

props.name: searchAction
props.type: { onClick: () => void; label?: string; icon?: IconName | ReactElement }
props.description:
For a Search control bar: while `collapsed`, the bar folds away and this Search action appears at the start of the
trailing slot (top-right); it leaves again when the bar expands. Its `onClick` usually scrolls back up and focuses
the field. Counts toward the three trailing actions, so keep at most two others. `label` defaults to the locale's
“Search”, `icon` to icon-search-medium-line (an icon name or an element).

props.name: scrollRef
props.description:
Scroll-linked collapse (the iOS large-title behaviour): the element whose scroll moves the screen's content, or
"window". The large title (and a Search Control-Bar with `searchAction`) slide up under the bar with the content,
1:1, never jumping; the bar title fades in once the large title is covered; a scroll that stops half-way settles
open or closed; once content runs under the bar, the opaque types (default · alt · compact · compact-alt) get a
Border/Neutral/Pale rule under the bar. The header must overlay the scrolled content: `sticky` as the scroller's
first child, or positioned over it. A `collapsed` value overrides it.

layout.extends: HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement>, LayoutSizingProps, LayoutPositionProps, FrameAppearanceProps, FrameTransformProps, FrameEffectProps

props.name: width
props.description:
Horizontal resizing, as in Figma auto layout. Unset keeps the element's usual width.
`"hug"` (Hug contents): as wide as its content, never grows or stretches.
`"fill"` (Fill container): in a row Stack it takes an equal share of the space left after each child's padding
and may shrink to 0; in a column Stack it stretches across; in a Grid cell or a plain block it takes the full
width. Fill children in a wrapping row need a `minWidth` to wrap.
A number: Fixed width in px, which never shrinks in a flex row. Sizes include padding and border (border-box).
(Container's `maxWidth` is a different prop: a token width, sm…full.)
Prefer hug or fill; use Fixed only for widths that really are fixed (a side column, a preview frame).

props.name: minWidth
props.description: Minimum width in px (Figma min width). Wins over fill's shrink-to-0.

props.name: maxWidth
props.description: Maximum width in px (Figma max width), e.g. a readable line length for a Fill block of text.

props.name: alignSelf
props.description:
This element's alignment inside its parent: start · center · end · stretch across a Stack's
direction (vertical in a row, horizontal in a column), vertical inside a Grid cell. Overrides the parent's `align`
for this child. A `"fill"` size on the same axis still fills; in a column, alignSelf then places it once maxWidth
stops it. No effect outside a Stack or Grid.

props.name: height
props.description:
Vertical resizing, as in Figma auto layout. Unset keeps the element's usual height.
`"hug"` (Hug contents): as tall as its content, never grows or stretches.
`"fill"` (Fill container): in a column Stack it takes an equal share of the free height; it shrinks below its
content only when the column has a height of its own (Fixed, Fill or maxHeight), else it keeps its content height
(pass `minHeight={0}` for a scrolling child of a column sized from outside). In a row Stack it stretches to the
row's height; in a Grid cell it fills the cell (over alignSelf); in a plain block it takes 100% (the parent needs
a height).
A number: Fixed height in px, which does not shrink in a column Stack.

props.name: minHeight
props.description: Minimum height in px (Figma min height). Wins over fill's shrink-to-0.

props.name: maxHeight
props.description: Maximum height in px (Figma max height).

props.name: position
props.description:
Figma "Ignore auto layout" (layoutPositioning ABSOLUTE). `"absolute"` takes the element out of its parent's flow
and pins it to the parent Stack, Grid, Box or Card with `constraintX` / `constraintY`; siblings, `gap`, `justify`
and the parent's Hug size ignore it, as in Figma. Siblings written after it paint above it (Figma auto layout
"Last on top"), so put background media first. Default `"static"` (in flow). Only Stack, Grid and Box take it:
wrap a Text or a component in a Box. Badges, status dots and a Card sub-action are component props, never insets.

props.name: constraintX
props.description:
Figma horizontal constraint, read only with `position="absolute"`: `left` (default, Figma Left) · `right` (Right)
· `left-right` (Left & right: stretches between the two offsets, `width` is ignored) · `center` (Center: exact
centre, the X offsets are ignored). Figma Scale is not offered (it needs percentages, which are not tokens).

props.name: constraintY
props.description:
Figma vertical constraint, read only with `position="absolute"`: `top` (default) · `bottom` · `top-bottom`
(Top & bottom: stretches between the two offsets, `height` is ignored) · `center` (exact centre).

props.name: insetTop
props.description:
Offset from the parent's top edge on Spacing/Padding (none 0 · 3xs 2 · 2xs 4 · xs 8 · sm 12 · md 16 · lg 20 ·
xl 24 · 2xl 32 · 3xl 40 · 4xl 48; Figma Y snapped to the padding ladder). Read only when `constraintY` pins the
top edge (`top`, `top-bottom`). Default none (flush). Measured from the parent's padding box, as Figma ignores the
frame's padding for absolute children. A number is px: Figma's Y in a free frame (a Box or Screen without auto
layout, where Zen Studio draws shapes and frames); it may be negative (the layer starts above the frame and clips).

props.name: insetRight
props.description: Offset from the parent's right edge on Spacing/Padding, or px in a free frame. Read only when `constraintX` is `right` or `left-right`. Default none.

props.name: insetBottom
props.description: Offset from the parent's bottom edge on Spacing/Padding, or px in a free frame. Read only when `constraintY` is `bottom` or `top-bottom`. Default none.

props.name: insetLeft
props.description: Offset from the parent's left edge on Spacing/Padding (Figma X snapped to the ladder), or Figma's X in px in a free frame. Read only when `constraintX` is `left` or `left-right`. Default none.

props.name: radiusTopLeft
props.description:
Top-left corner on the Corner-Radius tokens (Figma topLeftRadius; none · 2xs 2 · xs 4 · sm 8 · md 12 · lg 16 ·
xl 20 · 2xl 24 · 3xl 28 · full), following the radius mode. A set corner wins over `radius`, as `paddingX` wins
over `padding`; unset corners keep `radius`. Don't mix `full` with a finite corner (`radius="full"
radiusBottomRight="xs"`): `full` is Corner-Radius/Rounded (1000px), so the browser scales every corner down to fit
the box and the small one renders square. Use a finite radius (a chat tail: `radius="xl" radiusBottomRight="xs"`);
`full` mixes only with `none`.

props.name: radiusTopRight
props.description: Top-right corner on the Corner-Radius tokens (Figma topRightRadius). Wins over `radius`.

props.name: radiusBottomRight
props.description: Bottom-right corner on the Corner-Radius tokens (Figma bottomRightRadius). Wins over `radius`.

props.name: radiusBottomLeft
props.description: Bottom-left corner on the Corner-Radius tokens (Figma bottomLeftRadius). Wins over `radius`.

props.name: surface
props.description:
Fill: the background layer (docs/guidelines/background-layers.md), Figma's frame fill bound to its variable.
`surface` (Background/Surface/Default) for cards and panels on the Canvas page, `surface-alt` on a white (Alt)
canvas, `subtle` / `pale` (Background/Neutral) for wells. `canvas` (Background/Canvas/Default) is the page itself:
only for a whole screen or page area drawn inside something else (an app screen in a preview), never for a card.
Never Flat (navigation) or Container (modals and sheets use Dialog / BottomSheet). Default none.

props.name: border
props.description:
Stroke: a closed border, `subtle` (Border/Neutral/Subtle/Default) when the frame is actionable, `pale`
(Border/Neutral/Pale/Default) when it is static (docs/guidelines/borders.md). Inside the frame, as Figma's
Inside stroke. Default none.

props.name: borderWeight
props.description: Stroke weight in px (Figma strokeWeight), read with `border`. Default 1.

props.name: borderSides
props.description: Which sides the stroke draws (Figma's Stroke › sides): `all` (default) or one side, e.g. `bottom` for a bar's rule.

props.name: borderStyle
props.description: Figma's Stroke › Dash: `dashed` draws only with `border="subtle"` (dashed borders are always Subtle). Default solid.

props.name: radius
props.description: Corner radius on the Corner-Radius tokens (Figma cornerRadius, follows the radius mode); `radiusTopLeft` … `radiusBottomLeft` override single corners.

props.name: opacity
props.description: Layer opacity in percent (Figma's layer opacity, 0 … 100), the whole frame and its layers. Default 100.

props.name: rotation
props.description:
Rotation in degrees, counter-clockwise positive, as Figma's rotation field. Turns the frame about its centre; its
place in the layout stays (the rotated frame may overlap its neighbours, as in Figma).

props.name: flip
props.description: Figma's Flip horizontal (⇧H) or Flip vertical (⇧V): the frame mirrored on that axis, its place in the layout kept.

props.name: effectStyle
props.description:
Figma effect style (the whole style is the token, one per layer as in Figma). Drop shadows
(`Shadow/Bottom/Level-1…4`, `Shadow/Top/Level-1…4`) render only on `surface="surface"`, never on Subtle, Pale or
Surface-Alt (component-usage-rules §9) nor without a fill, and a shadowed surface takes no border (elevation follows
the Sidebar). `Shadow/Bottom/Level-1` is the Card (Theme=Shadow 7063:62203) and Sidebar elevation; the Top levels
cast upward for bottom-pinned bars (Bottom-Sheet 4059:14162 uses Top/Level-2). `Effect/Overlay` is the background
blur behind a translucent fill and renders only on `surface="subtle"` or `"pale"`. The shadows use the spread
tokens, which Figma draws on a filled, clipped frame: pair them with `clip` when children could overflow.

props.name: direction
props.description: column (default) stacks top to bottom; row lays items side by side.

props.name: gap
props.description: Space between items (Figma Spacing/Gap). Default md (16px).

props.name: align
justify
props.description: Main-axis distribution. `between` pushes the first and last items to the edges.

props.name: wrap
props.description: Let row items wrap onto new lines.

props.name: clip
props.description:
Figma "Clip content" (frame clipsContent): children are clipped to the frame's padding box, as Figma clips a frame.
Off by default, so the shadow of a card inside shows past the frame's edge. Uses `overflow: clip` (no scroll
container).

props.name: scroll
props.description:
Figma "Overflow scrolling": `"y"` scrolls the content vertically, `"x"` sideways, inside the stack's own box (it
needs a height or a maxHeight for `"y"`, a width for `"x"`); the scroll stays inside (overscroll-behavior: contain).

props.name: fillChildren
props.description:
Every child takes an equal share along the direction (Figma: all children Fill container), for children that have
no sizing props of their own (Button, Input, Card… but also a Divider or an Icon: wrap those in `<Box width="hug">`).
A child's own `width` (row) or `height` (column) wins; in a row children keep their own minimum width (a Button
never shrinks below its label). A column shares equally only when its height is Fixed or Fill (Buttons get
taller); with only a maxHeight the children keep their content height and shrink once it caps; without a height
they keep their content height.

props.name: padding
props.description: Space inside the stack (Figma Spacing/Padding), or a page margin that follows the breakpoint (`margin-comfortable`: 24, 20 on a phone; `margin-compact`: 20, 16 on a phone).

props.name: paddingX
props.description: Horizontal padding (overrides `padding` on the sides).

props.name: paddingY
props.description: Vertical padding (overrides `padding` top and bottom), e.g. page content inside a Container that already has side margins.

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref to the rendered DOM element (the `as` element when set).

props.description: Mobile Figma Hero (`band`, `band-sheet`): what the band shows under the TopNavigation (a balance, a profile, a summary).

props.name: backdrop
props.description: Mobile Figma Backdrop (`media`): the photo, video or map behind the top of the screen.

props.name: bottomNavigation
props.description: Mobile Figma Bottom Tab-Bar | Floating: the root navigation, a <BottomNavigation> (`floating-glass` floats over the page). Root screens only.

props.name: actionBar
props.description: Mobile Figma Bottom Actions: the screen's actions pinned to the bottom, an <ActionBar> (`surface="glass"` over photos).

props.name: sidebarCollapsed
props.description: Sidebar rail state when controlled; pair it with `onSidebarCollapsedChange`.

props.name: defaultSidebarCollapsed
props.description: Rail state to start from, uncontrolled. Default: the Sidebar's own `collapsed`; `list-detail` starts on the rail.

props.name: onSidebarCollapsedChange
props.description: Called when the toggle (or `useAppShell().setSidebarCollapsed`) collapses or expands the Sidebar. Store it to keep the choice between visits.

props.name: navOpen
props.description: Drawer state when controlled (drawer and mobile layouts).

props.name: navLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the navigation drawer. Default: the localized "Navigation".

props.name: mainId
props.description: Id of the main element, the target of the skip link.

props.name: layout
props.description:
Which structure to draw: `auto` (default) follows the shell's own width (1024px and up desktop; narrower, `mobile`
when a mobile part is given, else `drawer`), or force `desktop`, `drawer` or `mobile` (a design canvas, a preview).

props.name: children
props.description: Figma Content: the page (the Body pads Margin-Comfortable; Spacing/Gap/XSmall on desktop, Layout-Mobile/Section-Gap on mobile).

props.name: overrides
props.description: Figma instance overrides, by layer (`{ Close: { level: "secondary" } }`). Written by Zen Studio; app code sets the props.

props.name: ref
props.description: The root `<div>` element.

props.name: leading
props.description: Figma Top-Elements › Leading-Slots: where the user is, usually `<Breadcrumbs size="sm">`, or a Search. It grows.

props.name: center
props.description: Figma Center-Slots: the row's middle, up to 400px and centred between `leading` and `actions`, e.g. a Search.

props.name: actions
props.description:
Figma Trailing-Slots, Spacing/Gap/Small apart: a plan Badge, `AppShellAction` buttons (notifications, help), then
the account (`<Menu trigger={<AppShellAccount … />}>`). Page actions belong in `main`.

props.name: main
props.description: Figma Main-Element (the Main row): the page's own header, usually `<PageHeader title=… />` with its actions.

props.name: sections
props.description: Figma Sections: rows under the Main row, e.g. `<Tabs>` for the page's views or a toolbar of Search + filters.

props.name: overrides
props.description: Figma instance overrides, by layer (`{ Collapse: { level: "secondary" } }`). Written by Zen Studio.

props.name: ref
props.description: The root `<header>` element.

props.name: title
props.description: Figma Title (Heading/3, Content/Neutral/Strongest, one line, cut with "…"): the pane's heading and its region name.

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: Heading level of the title. Default 2: a pane sits beside the page's h1.

props.name: action
props.description:
Figma Action: one icon action at the end of the header, usually
`<IconButton appearance="flat" level="secondary" size="sm" …>` (a 20px glyph with a 32px hit area).

props.name: theme
props.description:
Figma Theme (Card's Neutral themes): `shadow` Surface + Shadow/Bottom/Level-1 (default) · `flat` · `border`
Border/Neutral/Pale · `pale` Support/Neutral/Pale · `subtle` Support/Neutral/Subtle (both with the Overlay blur) ·
`on-container` Surface/Flat, for a pane on a container · `canvas` no fill, for reading layouts (Docs).

props.name: surface
props.description: Figma Surface for the flat and border themes: `default` Surface/Default · `alt` Surface/Alt · `flat` Surface/Flat (border only).

props.name: children
props.description: Figma Pane-Content: the pane's body (a List, a tree, filters, a summary).

props.name: overrides
props.description: Figma instance overrides by layer. Written by Zen Studio; app code sets the props.

props.name: ref
props.description: The root `<section>` element.

props.name: icon
props.description: Figma Leading-Icon: an icon name (`"icon-bell-01-line"`) or a node.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: The action's name (“Notifications”): its accessible name, with the unread count added, and its 1s tooltip.

props.name: count
props.description: Figma Noti-type=Number: the unread count on a badge. 0 hides it; above 99 it reads "99+" (the accessible name keeps the exact number).

props.name: dot
props.description: Figma Noti-type=Dot: something new without a count. Hidden while a count shows.

props.name: tone
props.description: Figma Notification-Dot Theme: `default` Negative (needs attention) · `active` Positive · `accent`.

props.name: appearance
props.description: Figma Theme: `tertiary` (Button/Icon-Main Medium Tertiary, 40px) · `flat` (Button/Icon-Flat Medium Primary: a 20px glyph with a 40px hit area).

props.name: tooltip
props.description: Tooltip text. Default: `aria-label` (without the count).

props.name: overrides
props.description:
Figma instance overrides: props of the icon button it draws, by layer (`{ Button: { level: "secondary" } }`). Written by Zen Studio;
 app code sets icon / appearance.

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref to the icon button element, so the action can be a `<Menu trigger>`.

props.name: name
props.description: The signed-in person's name: the accessible name (“Account: Ava Chen”), the tooltip and the initials without a photo.

props.name: src
props.description: Photo URL (Figma Avatar/Single Theme=Photo).

props.name: theme
props.description: Initials colour without a photo. Default neutral.

props.name: overrides
props.description:
Figma instance overrides: props of the avatar it draws, by layer (`{ Avatar: { shape: "square" } }`). Written by Zen Studio;
 app code sets src / theme.

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref to the account button element, so it can be a `<Menu trigger>`.

props.name: title
props.description: The page title (an h1 by default: one per page).

props.name: childTitle
props.description:
Figma Child-Heading (Primitives/Dashboard/Header Type=Main, 4122:33399): a second title after the title, in the title's
type and Content/Neutral/Light, Spacing/Gap/XSmall after it — where the page is inside its parent ("Members" ›
"Design team"). Part of the heading, so the page's title reads both.

props.name: description
props.description: One or two sentences under the title.

props.name: breadcrumbs
props.description: Above the title: <Breadcrumbs> for nested pages.

props.name: eyebrow
props.description: Above the title when there are no breadcrumbs: a short section label.

props.name: actions
props.description: Page actions on the right of the title: Tertiary buttons first, then at most one Primary. They wrap under the title on narrow screens; on phones (ZenProvider breakpoint mobile) the Primary is shown first.

props.name: meta
props.description: Next to the title: a status Badge, Tag or AvatarStack.

props.name: trailing
props.description:
Figma Trailing-Slots (Primitives/Dashboard/Header Type=Main): icon actions after the page actions, e.g. a More menu or
 Share (Button/Icon-Main), Spacing/Gap/Small after them.

props.name: tabs
props.description: Under the header: <Tabs> that switch the page's sections.

props.name: back
props.description: A Back control for detail pages (chevron icon, per the navigation rule).

props.name: headingLevel
props.description:
Heading level of the title. Default 1 (Heading/1, the Figma Master-Layout page title); 2 only when the page already
 has an h1 (e.g. inside a tab), set in Heading/4 as the house ladder puts an h2. The text style follows the level.

props.name: overrides
props.description:
Figma instance overrides: props of the Back button it draws, by layer (`{ Back: { level: "secondary" } }`). Written by Zen Studio;
 app code sets back.

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref to the root DOM element.

props.name: type
props.description:
Figma Type. `control-bar` (Figma's default): Search, filter Chips, a result count and the actions. `navigation`:
Breadcrumbs on the left, notifications and the account on the right. `main`: the page title row — it renders a
PageHeader (use PageHeader directly when you also need breadcrumbs, tabs or Back). `custom`: your own row.

props.name: leading
props.description: Navigation · Figma Leading-Slots: usually <Breadcrumbs>. It fills the row's start.

props.name: center
props.description: Navigation · Figma Center-Slots (Nav-Center-Block): up to 400px in the middle of the row, e.g. a Search.

props.name: trailing
props.description:
Navigation and Main · Figma Trailing-Slots (Nav-Trailing-Block): icon actions then the account, right-aligned,
Spacing/Gap/Small apart — <AppShellAction> buttons (notifications with a dot or count) and an Avatar or account menu.

props.name: search
props.description: Control-Bar · Figma Search: a <Search size="md"> that filters the page, 320px wide.

props.name: controls
props.description: Control-Bar · Figma Control-Slots: filter Chips (`<Chip variant="advanced">`), Spacing/Gap/XSmall apart.

props.name: subheading
props.description:
Figma Subheading. Control-Bar: what the filters leave, e.g. "96 results" (Body/Base/Regular: a count, not a title;
user 2026-10-16). Main: one line under the title (the PageHeader description).

props.name: actions
props.description:
Control-Bar and Main · Figma Action-Slots: the page's buttons, right-aligned — Tertiary first, then at most one
Primary.

props.name: title
props.description: Main · Figma Header-Text: the page title (Heading/1, an h1 unless `headingLevel` is 2).

props.name: childTitle
props.description: Main · Figma Child-Heading: a second title after the title, in Content/Neutral/Light (PageHeader `childTitle`).

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: Main · heading level of the title (PageHeader `headingLevel`). Default 1.

props.name: children
props.description: Custom · Figma Custome-Elements: the row's content, Spacing/Gap/Medium apart and centred.

props.name: overrides
props.description: Figma instance overrides of the components in its slots, by layer. Written by Zen Studio; app code sets the slots.

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref to the root DOM element.

props.name: href
props.description: Destination URL. Required unless `as` renders a router link that takes its own destination prop (e.g. `to`).

props.name: external
props.description:
Opens the destination in a new tab: adds `target="_blank"`, `rel="noopener noreferrer"`, a trailing external-link icon
and a visually hidden “(opens in a new tab)” (in the locale's language), so the change of context is visible and announced. Use it for other
sites (docs, status pages, help centres), not for pages of the same app.

props.name: underline
props.description:
When the underline shows: `hover` (default; also on keyboard focus) for standalone links, `always` for links inside
running text so they never rely on colour alone, `none` only where the context already says it is a link
(a navigation list). Defaults to `always` when `tone="inherit"`.

props.name: tone
props.description:
Colour: `hyperlink` (default) uses Content/Hyperlink Default, Pressed while pressed and Visited (see `visited`);
`inherit` takes the surrounding text colour (footers, captions, legal lines) and is underlined by default.

props.name: visited
props.description:
Show the Content/Hyperlink/Visited colour once the destination has been visited. Default false: in-app links keep one
colour; turn it on for content links people scan repeatedly (search results, articles, docs). `hyperlink` tone only.

props.name: as
props.description:
Element or router component rendered instead of `<a>`, e.g. `as={RouterLink} to="/settings"` (React Router,
Next.js Link). Every other prop, the ref included, is forwarded to it.

props.name: children
props.description: The link text. Name the destination (“Billing settings”), never “click here”. The font comes from the surrounding Text.

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref to the rendered `<a>` element (or to the `as` component's element).

props.name: trigger
props.description:
The control that opens the menu: a Button or an IconButton with an aria-label (it names the menu too). It receives
aria-haspopup="menu", aria-expanded and aria-controls, and the opening keys (Enter · Space · ↓ first item, ↑ last item).

props.name: items
props.description: The actions: items, `{ type: "separator" }` and `{ type: "group", label, items }`. Without it, compose `children`.

props.name: children
props.description: Composable entries (`MenuItem`, `MenuSeparator`, `MenuGroup`), used when `items` is not given.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Called with the chosen item (after the item's own `onSelect`); then the menu closes and focus returns to the trigger.

props.name: align
props.description: Which edge of the trigger the menu lines up with: `start` (default) or `end` (a trigger at the right end of a row or card). Flips when it would leave the viewport.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state; pair it with `onOpenChange`. Default: uncontrolled and closed.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial state when uncontrolled. Default false.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called with `true` when the trigger opens the menu and `false` when it closes (choice, Escape, Tab, outside press).

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name of the menu. Default: the trigger's name (aria-labelledby).

props.name: className
props.description: Extra class on the floating surface.

props.name: overrides
props.description:
Figma instance overrides: props of the items (by item id) it draws, by layer (`{ "Item[delete]": { danger: true }, "Item[duplicate]/Icon": { tone: "accent-base" } }`). Written by Zen Studio;
 app code sets the items.

props.name: id
props.description: Stable id, handed back to the Menu's `onSelect`. Default: the label.

props.name: label
props.description: The action, verb first (“Duplicate”, “Move to…”). One line: a long label ends in “…”.

props.name: icon
props.description: Leading icon: an icon name (drawn at 20px) or an element. Give every item of a menu an icon, or none.

props.name: caption
props.description: A second line with a short consequence (“Anyone with the link can view”).

props.name: shortcut
props.description: Keyboard shortcut shown on the right (“⌘D”). Display only: the app wires the shortcut itself.

props.name: danger
props.description: Destructive action (Delete, Remove): Content/Negative text. Put it last, after a separator.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Not available right now: dimmed and skipped by the arrow keys.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Runs when the item is chosen (click, Enter or Space); then the Menu's `onSelect` runs and the menu closes.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra class on the row.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra class on the line.

props.name: label
props.description:
Small label above the items (“Share”, “Move to”); it names the group for screen readers (aria-labelledby). It is a
 label, not a heading, so a menu never adds to the page outline.

props.name: children
props.description: MenuItem and MenuSeparator elements.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra class on the group.

props.name: form
props.description:
The state from `useFormState()`. Form submits through `form.handleSubmit`: it validates, shows every error, moves
focus to the first invalid field and announces how many need attention. Pass either `form` or `onSubmit`.

props.name: onSubmit
props.description:
Your own submit handler, called after `preventDefault()` (e.g. react-hook-form's `handleSubmit(onValid)`). Return a
promise and Form waits for it; then, if any field is invalid (aria-invalid), it focuses the first one and announces the count.

props.name: gap
props.description: Space between the form's direct children (Figma Spacing/Gap): the groups of a form. Default lg (24px); fields inside a group use md.

props.name: invalidMessage
props.description: Screen-reader message after a failed submit. Default: the locale's "1 field needs attention" / "3 fields need attention".

props.name: noValidate
props.description: Skip the browser's own validation bubbles; Zen shows errors under each field. Default true.

props.name: children
props.description: The groups of the form, top to bottom: Stacks or Grids of fields, FormFieldsets, and FormActions last.

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref to the rendered `<form>` element.

props.name: label
props.description: The field label (Figma Input/Label, Body/Small/Regular). Omit it only when the control carries its own label (a Checkbox).

props.name: helpText
props.description: One line of guidance under the control (Help-Text, Neutral). Replaced by `error` while there is one.

props.name: error
props.description: The error message (Help-Text, Negative). Pass `form.fieldError(name)` so it shows at the right moment.

props.name: required
props.description: Adds " *" to the label and aria-required to the control. Mark the few optional fields instead when most are required.

props.name: optional
props.description: Figma Label `Optional`: appends "(Optional)".

props.name: labelTooltip
props.description: Figma Label `Tooltip-Icon`: an info icon with this text as a tooltip.

props.name: labelAction
props.description: Figma Label `Action`: a right-aligned link or text button ("Reset to default").

props.name: controlId
props.description: id given to the control (default: generated). The label points at it.

props.name: children
props.description:
Exactly one control. It receives `id`, `aria-labelledby`, `aria-describedby`, `aria-invalid` and `aria-required`,
so it must put them on its focusable element (Slider takes aria-labelledby; your own controls should take all five).

props.name: overrides
props.description:
Figma instance overrides: props of the label and help text it draws, by layer (`{ Label: { optional: true }, "Help-Text": { theme: "warning" } }`). Written by Zen Studio;
 app code sets label / helpText.

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref to the root `<div>` element.

props.name: legend
props.description: Names the group ("Delivery speed", "Email me about"); read before each option. Required.

props.name: hideLegend
props.description: Hide the legend visually (screen readers still read it) when a heading right above already names the group.

props.name: kind
props.description:
What the group holds. `radio` adds role="radiogroup" (with aria-required / aria-invalid), as the RadioButton
guideline asks; `toggle` spaces rows md; `checkbox`, `radio` and `group` space them sm. Default group.

props.name: direction
props.description: Stack the options (column, default) or lay them in a wrapping row (2–3 short options).

props.name: gap
props.description: Space between options (Figma Spacing/Gap). Default sm, or md for toggles.

props.name: helpText
props.description: One line of guidance for the whole group, under the options. Replaced by `error` while there is one.

props.name: error
props.description: The group's error ("Choose a delivery speed"). Pass `form.fieldError(name)`.

props.name: required
props.description: Adds " *" to the legend (and aria-required to a radio group): at least one option must be chosen.

props.name: optional
props.description: Figma Label `Optional`: appends "(Optional)" to the legend.

props.name: children
props.description: The options: Checkbox, RadioButton (sharing one `name`) or Toggle rows.

props.name: overrides
props.description:
Figma instance overrides: props of the help text it draws, by layer (`{ "Help-Text": { theme: "warning" } }`). Written by Zen Studio;
 app code sets helpText.

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref to the rendered `<fieldset>` element.

props.name: align
props.description:
Where the buttons sit on wide layouts: `end` (default, right), `start`, or `between` (the first child alone on the
left, e.g. "Delete draft", the rest on the right). Write Tertiary (cancel) first and Primary (submit) last in every case.

props.name: sticky
props.description: Keep the bar pinned to the bottom of the scrolling area (Surface background, Pale top line, safe-area padding).

props.name: inset
props.description: Sticky only: side padding of the bar, e.g. lg on a full-bleed phone screen so the buttons line up with the fields.

props.name: children
props.description: The buttons: Tertiary (cancel) first, Primary (`type="submit"`, named for the outcome) last.

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref to the root `<div>` element.

props.name: items
props.description: The rows, in reading order. Or pass DescriptionItem children (both render, items first).

props.name: layout
props.description:
inline (default): term at the start and value at the end of one line (order summaries, specs); it stacks by itself
when the list is narrower than `stackBelow`. stacked: term above value (profiles, addresses, long values).

props.name: divider
props.description: Pale rules (Border/Neutral/Pale) between rows, with Padding/Small above and below each rule. Default false.

props.name: stackBelow
props.description:
Inline layout only: below this width (px) of the list itself the rows stack (term above value). Default 280, so
lists in phone cards and sheets (about 300–350px) stay inline while narrow columns stack; 0 keeps them inline.

props.name: children
props.description: DescriptionItem rows.

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref to the rendered `<dl>` element.

props.name: term
props.description: The label (dt): Body/Small/Regular, Content/Neutral/Base.

props.name: description
props.description: The value (dd): Body/Base/Medium, Content/Neutral/Strongest.

props.name: action
props.description: An action for this row only (rendered in its own dd at the end of the row).

props.name: emphasis
props.description: The total row: Body/Base/Bold with a High rule above it. One per list.

props.name: className
props.description: On the row's div (the dt/dd group).

props.name: ref
props.description: The row's root `<div>` (the dt/dd group).

props.name: position
props.description:
sticky (default): stays at the bottom of the scrolling area while the content above scrolls, and settles at the end
of it. fixed: pinned to the bottom of the viewport; an invisible spacer of the bar's height keeps the end of the page
reachable. static: in the flow, e.g. the last row of a card.

props.name: direction
props.description:
vertical (default): full-width stacked Large buttons, Primary on top; the phone footer for one main action.
horizontal: Tertiary then Primary side by side. On a bar 480px or wider (desktop) the summary sits at the start and
Medium buttons hug their labels at the end; on a narrower bar (a phone, a narrow panel) the summary takes its own row
and Large buttons split the next one equally (the Figma Bottom-Sheet dual footer), for two peer actions such as
Clear all · Show results.

props.name: surface
props.description:
default: Surface/Default with a Pale (Border/Neutral/Pale) top rule. alt: Surface/Alt with the same rule. glass
(Figma Action-Bar/Mobile Type=Glass 16326:6489): no rule, a fade from Inverse/Flat to Surface/Default at 20% over a
progressive background blur, for a bar over photos or a long scroll. none: no fill and no rule, for a static bar
inside a container that already has one. Never a drop shadow.

props.name: primaryAction
props.description: The one main action (level primary). Rendered first (top) when vertical and last (end) when horizontal.

props.name: secondaryAction
props.description: One alternative (level tertiary), next to the primary: below it when vertical, before it when horizontal.

props.name: summary
props.description: Context for the actions: a total, a selection count or a status line. Above the buttons when vertical, at the start when horizontal.

props.name: children
props.description:
Custom actions (Buttons, in visual order: Primary first when vertical, last when horizontal). With primaryAction /
secondaryAction they sit on the side away from the Primary.

props.name: overrides
props.description:
Figma instance overrides: props of the Buttons it draws, by layer (`{ Primary: { level: "danger" } }`). Written by Zen Studio;
 app code sets primaryAction / secondaryAction.

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref to the bar's root element.

props.name: radiusTopLeft
props.description:
Top-left corner on the Corner-Radius tokens (Figma topLeftRadius; none · 2xs 2 · xs 4 · sm 8 · md 12 · lg 16 ·
xl 20 · 2xl 24 · 3xl 28 · full), following the radius mode. A set corner wins over `radius`, as `paddingX` wins
over `padding`; unset corners keep `radius`. Don't mix `full` with a finite corner (`radius="full"
radiusBottomRight="xs"`): `full` is Corner-Radius/Rounded (1000px), so the browser scales every corner down to fit
the box and the small one renders square. Use a finite radius (a chat tail: `radius="xl" radiusBottomRight="xs"`);
`full` mixes only with `none`.

props.name: radiusTopRight
props.description: Top-right corner on the Corner-Radius tokens (Figma topRightRadius). Wins over `radius`.

props.name: radiusBottomRight
props.description: Bottom-right corner on the Corner-Radius tokens (Figma bottomRightRadius). Wins over `radius`.

props.name: radiusBottomLeft
props.description: Bottom-left corner on the Corner-Radius tokens (Figma bottomLeftRadius). Wins over `radius`.

props.name: src
props.description: Image URL. While it is undefined (the URL is still being fetched) the Skeleton shows.

props.name: alt
props.description:
Required text alternative: what the picture shows, in context ("Matte black pour-over kettle, side view"). Use ""
only for a decorative picture that repeats text next to it; never a file name or "image of…".

props.name: ratio
props.description:
Frame ratio (width : height): "1:1" · "4:3" · "3:2" · "16:9" · "3:4", or a number (2.35). The frame keeps its size
while loading, so nothing jumps. Unset: the picture's own ratio (4:3 while it loads or fails).

props.name: fit
props.description: cover (default): fills the frame and crops. contain: shows the whole picture on Neutral/Pale bars (logos, documents).

props.name: radius
props.description:
Corner radius on the Zen scale (Corner-Radius): none · 2xs · xs · sm · md (default, 12) · lg · xl · 2xl · 3xl · full.
`radiusTopLeft` … `radiusBottomLeft` override single corners (Figma per-corner radius, e.g. top media in a card:
`radius="none" radiusTopLeft="2xl" radiusTopRight="2xl"`); unset corners keep this radius (md by default).

props.name: loading
props.description: Native loading: lazy (default) waits until the picture nears the viewport; eager for the first picture on screen.

props.name: caption
props.description: A caption under the picture (Body/Small/Regular, Content/Neutral/Base); the picture becomes a figure with a figcaption.

props.name: className
props.description: On the root (figure or div).

props.name: style
props.description: On the root (figure or div).

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref to the inner `` element (not the root).

props.name: src
props.description: Image URL. While it is undefined the Skeleton shows.

props.name: alt
props.description: Required text alternative. "" when the row already names the item (a ListItem title, a table cell label) next to it.

props.name: size
props.description:
Image-Size token: 3xs 16 · 2xs 20 · xs 24 · sm 32 · md 40 (default, a ListItem leading visual) · lg 48 · xl 56 ·
2xl 80 · 3xl 112 (compact density; comfortable scales them). Tables use sm with a caption, xs without.

props.name: shape
props.description: rounded (default: the radius steps with the size, like Avatar Square), circle, or square (no radius).

props.name: fit
props.description: cover (default) crops to the square; contain shows the whole picture (logos, app icons).

props.name: loading
props.description: Native loading: lazy (default) or eager.

props.name: className
props.description: On the root span.

props.name: style
props.description: On the root span.

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref to the inner `` element (not the root).

props.name: as
props.description:
Element to render. Default span: inline, so it is valid inside buttons, links and table headers. Use div or p for a
block, h2–h6 for a heading that names a region only screen readers need, label (with htmlFor) for a hidden field
label, and a (with href and focusable) for a skip link.

props.name: focusable
props.description:
Shows the content while it, or a link or button inside it, has focus: a Surface pill (Body/Base/Medium, Subtle
ring) at the top-start corner of the nearest positioned ancestor, above the page. Use it for skip links. Default false.

props.name: href
props.description: With `as="a"`: the link target, e.g. "#main".

props.name: htmlFor
props.description: With `as="label"`: the id of the control it labels.

props.name: children
props.description: The text for assistive technology (and for the visible pill while a focusable one has focus).

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref to the rendered DOM element (the `as` element when set).
